name: MONTAGE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD-H
summary: Montage Technology Co., Ltd. designs integrated circuits for cloud computing and data center customers in China. Based in Shanghai and established in 2004, it supplies memory module components, including registering and data buffers, clock drivers, temperature sensors and power management chips, along with complete memory modules, PCIe retimers, a CXL memory expander controller, clock chips and the Jintide server platform.
